Shell.Config.AiGrid.ChainHint: Click cells to choose which models serve each ability, in the order they are tried: a request goes to the first that is available. The Local column is the models on this machine, chosen on the Local page; a conversation, problem-solving or analysis row holding a model here and one elsewhere sends each request to the one that suits it. On a page holding system information, you are asked before its contents go to a model whose data leaves this machine.

Shell.Config.Local.Title: Local
Shell.Config.Local.Heading: Models on this machine
Shell.Config.Local.Intro: Choose the model this machine runs for each job. One that isn't here yet downloads when you choose it, and the job keeps its current model until it's done. On the AI page, the Local column says which abilities use them.
Shell.Config.Local.DictationNote: Dictation only: this machine can't run a speech model that holds a conversation, so the mic types what you say into the box, with Whisper base.
Shell.Config.Local.Job.VideoGeneration.R: From a description only: a clip that starts from a picture is made by the high-quality video model.
Shell.Config.Local.KeepingFormat: {0} stays in use until it's here.
Shell.Config.Local.ToolsIntro: Tools that run on this machine for you and for the assistant alike. Every workspace shares them.
Shell.Tools.Picture.Name: Picture tools
Shell.Tools.Picture.About: Upscale pictures, clean up softness, noise and JPEG blocks, and repair the faces in them — in the image editor, or when you ask the assistant. Real-ESRGAN and GFPGAN.
Shell.Tools.Selection.Name: Picture selection
Shell.Tools.Selection.About: Pick things out of pictures — click them, draw a box round them, or name them — and cut them out of their background, in the image viewer and editor or when you ask the assistant. SAM 3.1.
Shell.Tools.Reading.Name: Page reading
Shell.Tools.Reading.About: Read pages of writing — scans, photographed pages, scanned PDFs — into Markdown: columns as one text, formulas as LaTeX, tables, and figures, in the image and PDF viewers or when you ask the assistant. Unlimited-OCR and PP-OCRv5.
Shell.Tools.Erasing.Name: Erasing
Shell.Tools.Erasing.About: Rub scratches, dust, wires, people or signs out of photos and fill where they were from what is round them, in the image editor or when you ask the assistant about a picture you have open. LaMa.
